propositions: Blocking LINK events written before comparability became structural remain unresolved on read and distort ready/next-batch scheduling and parent-first cascade logic.

The doctor scan must detect three classes of blocking-edge errors: ancestor-blocking (endpoint is ancestor of other), mis-escalated (resolver returns different pair), and unreadable (endpoint could not reduce); mis-escalated and ancestor-blocking edges must be repairable while unreadable are reported only.

Repair writes the replacement link before removing the stale edge so interruption leaves a superset; it refuses ambiguous-pair cases (two net-active links on same ordered pair) where event model offers no relation-scoped unlink.
A read-only doctor run must not reconverge the store (init_only=True unless --repair flag present); run_repair must not hold a cross-item lock that blocks its own inner write acquisitions.
--repair refuses to run while a reconciler pass is in flight and writes nothing; pre-doctor-repair tag is force-written at pre-run OID as rollback anchor and re-pointed on subsequent repair runs.
On this repository tracker: 18 blocking edges found (9 ancestor-blocking, 9 mis-escalated); 12 repaired; 8 residual with closed BLOCKED-side endpoints that cannot affect scheduling.
